Title: Verify user can register and login successfully
Description: Verify a new user can register, login and access profile.
Test Steps:
1. Open Home Page.
2. Click Sign In/Register.
3. Register with valid details.
4. Login using registered credentials.
5. Navigate to My Profile.
Expected Output: Registration succeeds. User logs in successfully and profile information is displayed correctly.

Title: Verify complete purchase flow using Cash on Delivery
Description: Validate end-to-end purchase flow including invoice generation.
Test Steps:
1. Login.
2. Search a product.
3. Open product details.
4. Add product to cart.
5. Update quantity.
6. Checkout.
7. Select Cash on Delivery.
8. Place order.
9. Navigate to My Invoices.
Expected Output: Order is placed successfully. Invoice is generated and visible under My Invoices.

Title: Verify search, filter and sorting functionality
Description: Verify user can locate products using search, category, price range and sorting.
Test Steps:
1. Search for a product.
2. Apply Category filter.
3. Apply Price filter.
4. Sort Price Low?High.
Expected Output: Only matching products are displayed and sorting/filtering work correctly.

Title: Verify login with invalid credentials
Description: Verify system rejects invalid login attempts.
Test Steps:
1. Open Login page.
2. Enter invalid credentials.
3. Click Login.
Expected Output: Login fails and appropriate validation message is displayed.

Title: Verify checkout without mandatory fields
Description: Verify mandatory checkout fields are validated.
Pre-requisite: User logged in with product in cart
Test Steps:
1. Add product to cart.
2. Proceed to Checkout.
3. Leave mandatory fields blank.
4. Continue.
Expected Output: Mandatory validation messages are displayed and order is not placed.

Title: Verify quantity exceeding available stock
Description: Verify quantity cannot exceed available inventory.
Test Steps:
1. Open Product.
2. Enter quantity greater than stock.
3. Add to Cart.
Expected Output: System prevents adding quantity exceeding stock and shows an appropriate message.

Title: Verify cart persistence after session refresh
Description: Verify cart contents persist after browser refresh/login.
Test Steps:
1. Add products to cart.
2. Refresh browser.
3. Login again if required.
4. Open Cart.
Expected Output: Previously added products remain in the cart.

Title: Verify language change across pages
Description: Verify selected language persists while navigating the application.
Test Steps:
1. Change language.
2. Navigate to Product page.
3. Open Cart.
4. Open Checkout.
Expected Output: Selected language remains applied across all pages.
